_description: Literature-sourced values used in the report. Every number carries its source; null = not specified in the source consulted (never estimated).

references.Bonito 2013: Bonito G, Smith ME, Nowak M, et al. (2013). Historical biogeography and diversification of truffles in the Tuberaceae. PLOS ONE 8: e52765. doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0052765
references.Iotti 2018: Iotti M, et al. (2018). Draft genome sequence of Tuber borchii Vittad. Genome Announcements (PMC6013607; JGI MycoCosm Tubbor1).
references.Morin 2020: Morin E, Murat C, et al. (2020). Draft genome sequences of the black truffles Tuber brumale Vittad. and Tuber indicum Cook & Massee. Microbiology Resource Announcements.
